answer: Every submission sits in escrow against a jury quorum, and when two jurors diverge beyond tolerance the bond is slashed, so the escrow stays hollow until a panel closes and payout is never certain before then. Duplicate submissions forfeit the whole escrow, which kills the copy strategy at the kernel, and idle identities also bleed standing. Run the numbers: a thousand-account farm needs a thousand separate answers and a thousand bonds, and one repeated payload voids every copy of it before the summit.
